cohort: Post-partum women in Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of Congo, with infants weighing ≥4000 grams (macrosomia group) or 2500-3500 grams (control group).
finding: The incidence of fetal macrosomia was 5.7%, and risk factors included older maternal age, multiparity, multigravidity, obesity, diabetes, and previous macrosomic fetus.
